author: Infest
text:
This is also a good example how you can trade a setup two times.

1) The H4 DBD level was established and we retested it around 1485 with a
 fresh base level that got engulfed, so either take part of the drop
asap or

2) Wait for the retest of the new formed base supply level and take a short at 1480.

So even if you havent had the H4 DBD level around 1485-1495 on your
radar, you still couldve entered when price formed this nice base (that
engulfed previous demand).

I had a PO sitting just above it around 1487, and I wasnt trading that day, so unfortunately I didnt get in

author: Pedini
text: When trading PA and conformation is essential to me. Option 2 was the only logical trade in my books

author: sunnytrader1984
text:
@Infest

as you said there are several ways to trade this setup and I in no ways
would argue to that, everybody who trades, trades in his own way.

Like Pedini said, for us, the H4 supply above was just a level, where we
 expected price to show us something to trade. So the price came in,
made a nice RBD, but this is not enough if it does not engulf the last
swing low. If it would have stopped above the last swing low, we would
not trade it, since there can still be HHs forming. An engulf of swing
low is the PA which says to us, it is relatively safe taking the trade,
given somebody who has the might to make an engulf is selling here.

Once we have an engulf at a significant level, all we need to do is find
 a nice place to leave your order and let it do its thing.

nothing comes with a guarantee, but sometimes it comes with a high probability!

Hope this is helpful!

This is so true..

Ive lost a bit last week bc I was shorting Gold and Silver without
setup, as a PO and "touch-trade"... these setup can work but they are
dangerous without a base and engulfing of previous demand. It is kind of
 like a "hero-or-zero" trade...

I know that you, sunnytrader, are almost only trading these kind of trades, with this order:

1) Find HTF supply and demand zones

2) Wait for price to establish fresh supply / demand within the PA zone

3) Only trade the retest of the fresh level (only if a level is engulfed)

So how are you handling the fact that you maybe miss good trades because
 price sometimes doesnt even have a retest close to the
"level-to-watch", kind of like a scared cat running away rapidly?

This is like a vicious circle to me.

author: sunnytrader1984
text:
@Infest

Good question Infest, but to this I have just one answer," there are unlimited opportunities but limited money in my account".

So if I dont get a fill at my price its ok, most likely I was not
aligned with the big money and I should be looking elsewhere for another
 opportunity setting up. If you follow enough instruments, there is no
shortage of opportunities. With enough I don't mean every instrument.
With as many as 10-12 you will have a few good opportunities setting up
quite often, often enough to keep your account growing.

Follow a system that works consistently over time, you will see the
results. Keep breaking your rules more often than not, you will see the
consequence. Trust me, I have done that and repented like hell.

Good luck buddy. Have lots of green this week.
